206481 NOTICE TO SUBCONTRACTORS AND SUPPLIERS Washington State University, acting by and through the Vice President for Finance and Administration, hereby advises all interested parties that Contract No. 1T01387, for the Building Systems Infrastructure Upgrade project, Washington State University, Pullman, Puyallup, Prosser, and Spokane, WA, with Skanska USA Building, Inc. 400 Fairview Ave North Suite 1000, Seattle, WA 98109, has achieved Final Acceptance as of November 9, 2026. The legal lien period becomes effective for the filing of all liens and claims against the retained percentage of payment to the Contractor on the above date. Any liens filed after December 24, 2026, will not be recognized. Maja S. Huff 509 335-9082 contracts@wsu.edu Facilities Services Washington State University
